landingMinProducts.title: Products in stock to index
landingMinProducts.description: A landing page set to Automatic is indexed by search engines while at least this many of its products are in stock.

landingUrl.title: Landing page address
landingUrl.description: Where a landing page is on your website: {categoryUrl} (its category's page), {category}, {brand} and {grade}, for example {categoryUrl}?brand={brand}&grade={grade}. Empty values are left out.

attributeUrl.title: Attribute glossary address
attributeUrl.description: Where an attribute's glossary page is on your website, with {slug} and {category} (the category's slug), for example /glossary/{slug} or /attributes/{category}/{slug}. With {category}, an attribute defined for one category has its page there, one for every category a page in each category it names. Set, every active attribute's page is listed in the sitemap. Empty: there are no attribute glossary pages.

attributeTitle.title: Attribute glossary title
attributeTitle.description: An attribute glossary page's part of the page title when it has no SEO title: {name} is the attribute, {unit} its unit, {values} its first values, {category} the page's category, {storeName} the name in titles, for example What is {name}?

attributeDescription.title: Attribute glossary description
attributeDescription.description: Used when an attribute has no SEO description or text of its own, with the same placeholders, for example {name} ({unit}) for {category}: {values}. Empty: the default description.

gradeUrl.title: Grade glossary address
gradeUrl.description: Where a grade's glossary page is on your website, with {key} and {category} (the category's slug), for example /grades/{key} or /grades/{category}/{key}. With {category}, a grade defined for one category has its page there, one for every category a page in each category it names. Empty: there are no grade glossary pages (they are left out of the sitemap).
